items.title: org.machanism.machai:mcp-server-maven-plugin 1.3.2 发布, The MCP Server Maven Plugin integrates a Machai Model Context Protocol (MCP) server into a Maven build through aggregator goals for stateless and streamable HTTP transports. It uses the current project's name, version, and base directory, loads the configured PropertiesConfigurator, applies Maven parameters without overriding existing system properties, registers the configured Machai AI tools, and starts the selected server. The plugin exposes those tools to MCP clients without a separate launcher, supporting local development, repeatable integration tests, demonstrations, and build-driven automation, while its aggregator goals support multi-module builds by starting one server for the reactor.

eu.ciechanowiec:airness-assets 1.0.4 发布, The files the harness owns but cannot supply from a classpath, and the manifest saying what a
        project may do with each.

        Most of the harness reaches a project as configuration an analyzer reads off its own plugin
        classpath, which is why most of it needs no file in the project at all. What lands here is what
        something outside Maven reads from disk: an editor reading .editorconfig, git reading
        .gitattributes. Those have nowhere else to live, so they live in the project and are checked
        against the bytes shipped here.

        Each canonical file is stored under an added .asset suffix. A stored .gitignore under its own
        name would be a working .gitignore over this directory and could stop its neighbours from being
        tracked, and a stored .gitattributes would take effect over them. A file that changes the meaning
        of the directory it sits in cannot be stored under its own name.

eu.ciechanowiec:airness-annotations 1.0.4 发布, The annotation the rule set expects to find in a consumer's source. This is the only Airness
        artifact that reaches a consuming project's compile classpath, which is why it is an artifact of
        its own rather than a package inside airness-config: folding it in would put the analyzer
        configurations on that classpath as well, to no purpose.

        It carries no dependencies and no runtime cost. The annotation has SOURCE retention, so it does
        not survive compilation into the consumer's artifact.

eu.ciechanowiec:airness-maven-plugin 1.0.4 发布, The Maven goals that bind governance checks and explicit repair operations to the build. Checks
        are read-only. Repair goals run only when called directly.

        A check that shipped as a test could be accidentally deselected by -Dtest=OneClass. As goals the
        checks stay bound to their phases, their parameters are named and typed, and a failure names the
        check in the line that reports it. Every check and writing goal explicitly honors -DskipTests as
        the quality and governance bypass.
